name: Bheja Fry Year End Open 2017

venue.name: Skill Centre of Excellence
venue.address: Skill Centre of Excellence, #300, 6th main, Arekere MICO Layout Stage 1, Bengaluru - 560076

information:
Online registration ends on 28th December, 2017. On the spot registration is available. Visit [registration & payment tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BhejaFryYearEndOpen2017#3377-registration-payment) for more details.
If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration.

**First time participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab

**Other participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions
Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned)
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab

The winner of MBLD event will be declared the competition winner.
